rigorous.en: The research team followed a rigorous process before publishing its results.
rigorous.zh: 研究團隊在發表結果前遵循嚴謹的流程。

rim.en: A thin line of frost formed around the rim of the window.
rim.zh: 窗框邊緣形成了一圈薄霜。

rip.en: Be careful not to rip the paper while opening the envelope.
rip.zh: 打開信封時小心不要撕破紙張。

ripe.en: The mango is ripe enough to eat this afternoon.
ripe.zh: 這顆芒果已經熟到今天下午可以吃了。

ripple.en: A small stone created a ripple across the quiet pond.
ripple.zh: 一顆小石頭在平靜的池塘上激起漣漪。

risky.en: Relying on one source alone can be risky for research.
risky.zh: 研究只依賴單一來源可能有風險。

ritual.en: Morning assembly became a familiar ritual for the students.
ritual.zh: 晨會成了學生熟悉的例行活動。

rival.en: The two schools are friendly rival teams in the annual tournament.
rival.zh: 這兩所學校是年度賽事中的友好競爭對手。

rivalry.en: Their rivalry became stronger after several close matches.
rivalry.zh: 幾場勢均力敵的比賽後，他們的競爭更加激烈。

roach.en: A roach appeared near the storage room after heavy rain.
roach.zh: 大雨過後，儲藏室附近出現了一隻蟑螂。

roam.en: Visitors can roam through the garden during opening hours.
roam.zh: 開放時間內，遊客可以在花園裡自由走動。

roar.en: We could hear the roar of the waterfall from far away.
roar.zh: 我們從很遠的地方就能聽見瀑布的轟鳴聲。

roast.en: The café serves a dark roast coffee in the morning.
roast.zh: 這間咖啡館早上供應深度烘焙咖啡。

robe.en: The actor wore a long robe in the historical play.
robe.zh: 演員在歷史劇中穿著一件長袍。

robot.en: The student-built robot moved across the classroom floor successfully.
robot.zh: 學生製作的機器人成功在教室地板上移動。

rock.en: A large rock blocked part of the mountain trail.
rock.zh: 一塊大石頭擋住了部分山路。

rocket.en: The science museum displayed a model rocket near the entrance.
rocket.zh: 科學博物館在入口附近展示了一枚模型火箭。

rocky.en: The trail became rocky as we climbed higher into the hills.
rocky.zh: 我們爬得越高，步道就變得越多岩石。

rod.en: The experiment used a metal rod to support the structure.
rod.zh: 這項實驗用一根金屬棒支撐結構。

roll.en: Please roll the poster carefully before placing it in the tube.
roll.zh: 把海報放入紙筒前請小心捲起來。

roof.en: Rainwater collected on the roof after the afternoon storm.
roof.zh: 午後暴雨後，雨水積在屋頂上。

rooster.en: A rooster crowed loudly just before sunrise on the farm.
rooster.zh: 農場上的公雞在日出前大聲啼叫。

root.en: The tree's root system helps keep the soil in place.
root.zh: 樹木的根系有助於固定土壤。

rope.en: The guide used a rope to mark the edge of the trail.
rope.zh: 嚮導用繩子標示步道邊界。

rose.en: A red rose bloomed beside the school garden fence.
rose.zh: 一朵紅玫瑰在校園花圃的籬笆旁盛開。

rot.en: Fruit can rot quickly when stored in a warm place.
rot.zh: 水果放在溫暖的地方時可能很快腐爛。

rotate.en: Students rotate roles so everyone can practice each task.
rotate.zh: 學生輪流更換角色，讓每個人都能練習各項任務。

rotation.en: The club uses a weekly rotation for cleaning shared equipment.
rotation.zh: 社團採用每週輪替制度清潔共用設備。

rotten.en: The gardener removed a rotten apple from the basket.
rotten.zh: 園丁從籃子裡拿走一顆腐爛的蘋果。

roughly.en: The trip takes roughly two hours by train from here.
roughly.zh: 從這裡搭火車大約需要兩個小時。

row.en: We sat in the second row during the school performance.
row.zh: 我們在學校表演時坐在第二排。

royal.en: The museum displayed clothing once worn by the royal family.
royal.zh: 博物館展示了王室成員曾穿過的服飾。

royalty.en: The exhibit explores how royalty influenced art and architecture.
royalty.zh: 展覽探討王室如何影響藝術與建築。

rub.en: Do not rub the page because the ink is still wet.
rub.zh: 墨水還沒乾，請不要摩擦紙面。

rubber.en: The wheels are made from durable rubber for better grip.
rubber.zh: 輪子由耐用橡膠製成，以增加抓地力。

rubbish.en: Volunteers collected rubbish along the riverbank on Saturday morning.
rubbish.zh: 志工週六早上沿河岸撿拾垃圾。

rude.en: Interrupting someone repeatedly can seem rude during a discussion.
rude.zh: 討論時一再打斷別人可能顯得沒禮貌。

rug.en: A small rug covered the floor beside the reading chair.
rug.zh: 閱讀椅旁的地板鋪著一張小地毯。

rugged.en: The hikers crossed rugged terrain during the mountain trip.
rugged.zh: 健行者在山區行程中穿越崎嶇地形。

ruin.en: One careless mistake could ruin the final presentation file.
ruin.zh: 一次粗心的錯誤可能毀掉最後的簡報檔。

ruler.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line across the page.
ruler.zh: 用尺在紙上畫一條直線。

rumor.en: The principal asked students not to spread an unconfirmed rumor.
rumor.zh: 校長請學生不要散播未經證實的謠言。

runner.en: The fastest runner finished the final lap in strong form.
runner.zh: 最快的跑者以良好狀態完成最後一圈。

rural.en: The documentary compares rural schools with schools in large cities.
rural.zh: 紀錄片比較鄉村學校與大城市學校。

rush.en: There is no need to rush when checking your answers.
rush.zh: 檢查答案時沒有必要匆忙。

rust.en: The old gate showed signs of rust after many rainy seasons.
rust.zh: 經過多個雨季後，舊鐵門出現鏽蝕痕跡。

rusty.en: The bicycle chain became rusty after being left outside.
rusty.zh: 自行車鏈條放在戶外後生鏽了。

sack.en: The farmer carried a sack of rice into the storage room.
sack.zh: 農夫把一袋米搬進儲藏室。

sacred.en: The temple is considered a sacred place by local residents.
sacred.zh: 當地居民把這座寺廟視為神聖之地。

sacrifice.en: Finishing the project required some sacrifice of free time.
sacrifice.zh: 完成這個專題需要犧牲一些休閒時間。
